title: Same Words, Different Answers: Segmentation Sensitivity of LLM-Derived Views (artifact)
description: Code, preregistration, cached model outputs and scripts that regenerate every number, table and figure of the paper 'Same Words, Different Answers: Segmentation Sensitivity of LLM-Derived Views' (submitted to the ICDE 2027 Experiment, Analysis and Benchmark track; withdrawn by the authors on 2026-11-14 for an administrative reason, a co-author's submission limit; the work continues in an extended version). Code and results are unchanged from v1.3. Source corpora (AMI Meeting Corpus audio and annotations, Wikipedia text) are not redistributed; scripts download them.
